description: Minified or compiled JavaScript module exporting semver comparison and range utilities, including classes Comparator, Range, and SemVer, with associated methods for version parsing, comparison, and range checking.

classes.name: Comparator
classes.description: Represents a version comparator with methods for parsing, testing, and intersecting version ranges.

classes.name: Range
classes.description: Represents a semantic version range with methods for parsing, testing, and formatting range expressions.

classes.name: SemVer
classes.description: Represents a semantic version with methods for comparison, incrementing, and formatting.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a version or range string into internal representation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the comparator or range.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Tests if a version satisfies the comparator or range.

methods.name: intersects
methods.description: Checks if two comparators or ranges intersect.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the range object into a string.
